description_good_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/README.md -- the opening paragraph says what the plugin does: it mentors one learner on Claude and Claude Code, adding at most one tip when it fits.
interact_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/README.md (Quickstart, Manage the plugin) says how to get it, and https://github.com/monte3l/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md, the organization default, says how to give feedback and contribute. GitHub shows it on every new issue and pull request.
contribution_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md -- the organization's default contributing guide covers issues, commits and the pull request process. This repository has no CONTRIBUTING.md of its own, so GitHub serves the default.
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md -- Conventional Commits, sign-off, signed commits, the coding standards and the repository's full check are required.
floss_license_justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
floss_license_osi_justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
documentation_basics_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/README.md explains installing, the skills and the settings, and https://claude-mentor.monte3l.com publishes the same pages.
documentation_interface_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/README.md (Skills, Settings, Permissions) documents the external interface: the skill names, the two plugin options and the permission rules. https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/docs/spec.md documents the CLI commands and the hook events.
sites_https_justification: The repository, the docs site (https://claude-mentor.monte3l.com) and the catalogue it installs from are all served over HTTPS.
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are searchable, addressable by URL, and open to anyone with a GitHub account, with no proprietary client needed.
english_justification: The documentation, issues and code comments are in English, and the maintainers read and write English.
maintained_justification: Actively developed: releases 0.1.0 (2026-11-12) and 0.2.0 (2026-11-14), and about 95 commits in the last 90 days.
repo_track_justification: Git tracks every change, with author and date.
repo_interim_justification: Work lands on feature branches and pull requests before it reaches `main`, so interim versions are public.
repo_distributed_justification: Git is a distributed version control system.
version_unique_justification: Every release has a unique version, set by release-please from the Conventional Commits and recorded in `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`.
version_semver_justification: Releases follow Semantic Versioning: see the Versioning policy in https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/README.md.
version_tags_justification: Each release has a git tag, `m3l-claude-mentor--vX.Y.Z` (for example `m3l-claude-mentor--v0.1.0`).
release_notes_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md, generated by release-please from the commits, and the GitHub release for each version summarize what changed.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No release so far has fixed a publicly known vulnerability in the plugin's own code. A dependency advisory (minimatch, GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249) was fixed in the development toolchain only, which no release ships.
report_process_justification: Bug reports go through GitHub issues, using the organization's issue forms (bug report, docs problem, feature request, question). https://github.com/monte3l/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md describes the process; vulnerabilities go through https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/SECURITY.md.
report_responses_justification: No bug report has been received yet, so none is unanswered. The target is an acknowledgement within 7 days (SECURITY.md covers vulnerabilities).
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement request has been received yet, so none is unanswered. Requests are answered on the issue.
report_archive_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/issues keeps every report and response, publicly searchable.
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/SECURITY.md says how to report a vulnerability and what to expect.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: GitHub private vulnerability reporting is enabled: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/security/advisories/new, linked from SECURITY.md.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: SECURITY.md sets a target of acknowledging within 7 days, inside the 14-day criterion. No vulnerability report has been received yet.
build_justification: `pnpm build` compiles the TypeScript with `tsc` into `dist/`, which is committed, and CI checks that `dist/` matches a fresh build.
build_common_tools_justification: The build uses `tsc` and `pnpm`, the common tools for TypeScript.
build_floss_tools_justification: Node.js, pnpm and TypeScript are all FLOSS.
test_justification: A Vitest suite of about 2,300 tests runs with `pnpm test`, and the coverage gate runs in CI.
test_invocation_justification: `pnpm test` runs the suite, the standard command for a pnpm project.
test_most_justification: Vitest measures coverage with an 80% per-file gate on `src/`. The files that spawn a process (hook entries and the CLI shim) are excluded from coverage and tested by running `dist/`.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: The CI workflow runs the test lane with coverage on every pull request and push to `main`.
test_policy_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md requires tests for new behaviour and a regression test for a fix, and https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/CLAUDE.md makes `pnpm verify` the definition of done.
tests_are_added_justification: Each feature and fix of this project landed with tests in the same pull request: see the merged pull requests.
tests_documented_added_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests and the pull request template both state the policy.
warnings_justification: The TypeScript compiler runs with `strict: true`, and ESLint with the typed recommended rules, on every `pnpm verify` and in CI.
warnings_fixed_justification: CI fails on a compiler or linter error, so none reaches `main`.
warnings_strict_justification: TypeScript runs with strict, exactOptionalPropertyTypes, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, noImplicitReturns and noImplicitOverride, ESLint uses the typed recommended rules, and unused disable directives are errors. CI fails on any error.
crypto_published_justification: The plugin implements no cryptography and calls no crypto library.
crypto_call_justification: The plugin implements no cryptography and calls no crypto library.
crypto_floss_justification: The plugin implements no cryptography and calls no crypto library.
crypto_keylength_justification: The plugin implements no cryptography and calls no crypto library.
crypto_working_justification: The plugin implements no cryptography and calls no crypto library.
crypto_pfs_justification: The plugin implements no network protocol with key agreement.
crypto_password_storage_justification: The plugin stores no passwords and authenticates no user.
crypto_random_justification: The plugin generates no cryptographic keys or nonces.
delivery_mitm_justification: The plugin is delivered by cloning from https://github.com over HTTPS, through the monte3l catalogue (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-plugins), pinned to a release tag and full commit SHA.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No checksum or signature is fetched over plain HTTP. Delivery is a git clone over HTTPS at a pinned commit.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No publicly known medium-or-higher vulnerability has been unpatched for 60 days: Dependabot shows no open alert, and the one CodeQL finding (alert #1, 2026-11-04) was fixed in 11 days.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerability has been reported. Dependabot security updates and CodeQL alerts are watched and fixed promptly.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: Secret scanning and push protection are enabled, and the Gitleaks workflow runs on every pull request. No credential is stored in the repository.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (default setup, javascript-typescript and actions) runs on every pull request and weekly, https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/security/code-scanning, and ESLint and `tsc` run in CI.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL runs the extended query suite, which covers the common vulnerability classes for JavaScript and TypeScript (CWE-mapped).
static_analysis_fixed_justification: CodeQL alert #1 (js/file-system-race, high) was fixed in pull request #33 within 11 days. No medium-or-higher exploitable finding is open.
static_analysis_often_justification: Static analysis runs on every pull request and on a schedule.
dynamic_analysis_justification: No dynamic analysis such as fuzzing is run yet. The inputs are local only (see the Fuzzing entry in SECURITY.md).
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: No memory-unsafe code: TypeScript on a managed runtime.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: No dynamic analysis is run, so assertions are not enabled for one.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No dynamic analysis is run, so there are no findings to fix.
dco_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#commits -- every commit needs a Signed-off-by trailer, and the required `DCO sign-off` check fails a pull request without one.
governance_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/docs/GOVERNANCE.md -- a single-maintainer model with the decision process written down.
code_of_conduct_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/.github/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, the organization default that applies to this repository. https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#conduct links it.
access_continuity_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/docs/GOVERNANCE.md#access-continuity -- two organization owners who each hold the ruleset, the secrets and the release App independently, and a release path no one person holds.
bus_factor_justification: Direction rests with one maintainer today, although both owners can review, merge and release. https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/docs/GOVERNANCE.md#bus-factor.
documentation_security_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/README.md#how-it-works says what the plugin stores and what it never stores, https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/README.md#permissions explains the allow rules, and https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md says what a user can and cannot expect.
documentation_current_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests requires the README tables to change with a skill, an option or the export format, and scripts/doc-parity.mjs fails the docs check when a documented skill, option default or Node version drifts from the code.
documentation_achievements_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/README.md shows the OpenSSF Best Practices badge for project 16729, and the Scorecard and REUSE badges.
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: No UI of its own. The surfaces are plain text in Claude Code, command output and GitHub's own pages.
internationalization_justification: The plugin ships no localizable end-user strings: the tips and lessons are written by the model in the learner's own language, and the skills and docs are in English.
sites_password_security_justification: No project-controlled site stores passwords. The docs site is static.
maintenance_or_update_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions and https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/SECURITY.md#scope-and-duration-of-support state what is supported and for how long.
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/SECURITY.md#credit -- the advisory credits the reporter unless they ask not to be named. No vulnerability report has been resolved yet.
coding_standards_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-standards names .editorconfig, strict TypeScript with ESM only, typed ESLint, the per-file coverage gate and the file-size budget.
coding_standards_enforced_justification: `pnpm verify` and the CI lanes run Prettier, ESLint and tsc strict over every file, guard-no-commonjs.mjs refuses CommonJS, and the coverage gate fails below 80% per file. A failing check blocks the merge.
build_standard_variables_justification: A TypeScript project compiled with tsc. There is no C-style toolchain with variables such as CC or CFLAGS to honour.
build_preserve_debug_justification: tsc emits source maps and declaration maps (sourceMap and declarationMap in tsconfig.base.json), and no step strips them.
build_non_recursive_justification: One tsc project build, with no recursive make-style build.
build_repeatable_justification: The committed dist/ must equal a fresh build: the dist-fresh step rebuilds it in CI and fails on any difference, so the output is the same wherever it is built.
installation_common_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/README.md#quickstart -- the standard `claude plugin install` and `/plugin install` commands.
installation_standard_variables_justific: A plugin is installed by Claude Code into its own plugin directory. There is no install-location convention such as DESTDIR.
installation_development_quick_justifica: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/README.md#working-on-this-repo and https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#building-and-testing -- clone the repository, run `pnpm install` and `pnpm verify`.
external_dependencies_justification: The hooks and the CLI have no external runtime dependency: they use only Node's built-in modules, and the plugin makes no network call of its own. The development packages are still listed in machine-readable form in package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml, and the docs deploy tool in tools/deploy/package.json with its lockfile.
dependency_monitoring_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/.github/workflows/dependency-review.yml fails a pull request on a high-severity vulnerability, and Dependabot (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml) proposes updates. A security advisory it cannot resolve is fixed with a pnpm override, as with minimatch.
updateable_reused_components_justificati: The reused components are npm packages and GitHub Actions, pinned by lockfile and commit SHA, and Dependabot proposes bumps. Nothing is copied into the source.
interfaces_current_justification: The plugin uses the current Claude Code plugin interface (manifest, userConfig, hooks, skills, agents and output style), and a live `claude plugin eval` run confirms the skills and agents dispatch.
automated_integration_testing_justificat: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml runs the whole suite, including tests that spawn the built hooks and CLI, on every push and pull request, and reports one aggregated verify status.
regression_tests_added50_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests requires a regression test for a fix. Of the two fix commits in the last six months, the one that changed behaviour (the release pull request failing the manifest-version test) changed that test, and the other moved a CI folder, which has no unit-testable behaviour.
test_statement_coverage80_justification: Vitest measures about 98% of statements and 97% of branches, with an 80% per-file gate in CI. Files that only spawn a process are tested by running dist/.
test_policy_mandated_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests -- new behaviour needs tests, and the coverage gate fails below 80% per file.
crypto_credential_agility_justification: No cryptographic credential is embedded in the software.
crypto_used_network_justification: No cryptography, and the hooks and CLI use no network.
crypto_tls12_justification: The hooks and CLI make no network call.
signed_releases_justification: Releases are git tags created by the release workflow, and 0.1.0 and 0.2.0 carry no signed asset. The release workflow now builds a source tarball and attaches it with a Sigstore build-provenance attestation, verifiable with `gh attestation verify` (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-releases). This becomes Met once the first release carrying it has been verified.
version_tags_signed_justification: The release tags are lightweight tags made by the release workflow, not signed tags. The org tags ruleset stops one being moved or deleted.
input_validation_justification: Hook payloads, state files and import bundles are validated against a schema at the boundary, and the CLI rejects relative paths and bad values, all covered by tests: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/src/internal/schema.ts and https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md.
hardening_justification: The plugin is a set of local hooks, a CLI and Markdown skills, not a web application that serves headers. The static docs site does send security headers (a CSP and HSTS) from its _headers file.
know_secure_design_justification: The maintainers apply the secure design principles and have written down how, with where each is enforced: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md#secure-design-principles-applied covers economy of mechanism, fail-safe defaults, complete mediation, open design, separation of privilege, least privilege, least common mechanism and psychological acceptability. https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md#threat-model and https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/docs/spec.md (section 10, state and privacy) show the design built on them.
know_common_errors_justification: The maintainers know the common kinds of errors for this kind of software (a TypeScript plugin that parses JSON, runs local hooks and a CLI, and fetches pages) and one counter for each: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-claude-mentor/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md#common-implementation-weaknesses-countered lists information exposure (CWE-200), improper input validation (CWE-20), command and code injection (CWE-78, CWE-94), path traversal (CWE-22), time-of-check to time-of-use (CWE-367), prompt injection through fetched text (CWE-77), hard-coded credentials (CWE-798) and untrusted components (CWE-1357 and CWE-829), each with the mitigation and where it is enforced.
